text: From 2026-11-01, @gitdek's watchers run Codex at `ultra` again, `-codex-effort`'s default, with the loop guard's fallback at `xhigh`, `-fallback-effort`'s default, by his call. His Codex usage was reset, and the factory's next work, #391 to #393, includes the gate's observation core, where soundness matters most. This replaces D-0174's `high` and `medium`.
